preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of people n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in [int(x) for _ in range(t) for x in input().split()])
preconditions.description: For each person in each test case, the sociability parameter a_i is between 0 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(a_i for a_i in [int(x) for _ in range(t) for x in input().split()]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of all a_i over all test cases and all i does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 0 <= k <= sum(a_i) for k, a_i in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [int(x) for _ in range(t) for x in input().split()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of talks k is between 0 and the sum of all a_i for that test case inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(talks) == k for k, talks in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of talks k matches the number of talk pairs provided.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(i) <= n and 1 <= int(j) <= n and i != j for i, j in zip(talks[::2], talks[1::2])) for n, talks in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, each talk pair consists of two distinct people within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(talks)) == len(talks) for talks in [input().split() for _ in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, each talk pair is unique.
